artworks.title: Saint John Sees the Seven Golden Candlesticks
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures surrounded by ornate candleholders and clouds. In this composition, one figure is seated on a cloud holding keys and a scroll, with a halo around its head. Below, another figure kneels, touching one of the candleholders, which stand tall, forming a decorative archway around them. The background is filled with swirling clouds and an aura of light radiates around the seated figure. The intricate detailing of the clothing, hair, and faces give this drawing an ornate, classical feel.

artworks.title: Saint John Summoned to Heaven
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.9 × 21 cm (11 3/4 × 8 1/4 in.)
mount: 39.4 × 29.2 cm (15 1/2 × 11 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a central throne surrounded by various figures and symbolic elements. The artwork shows a seated figure on a throne at the center, with other figures around them, some with wings and various expressions. The figures interact in complex ways, depicted with detailed clothing, drapery, and textures. The scene also includes architectural elements and symbols, creating a rich visual composition of celestial grandeur.

artworks.title: The Angel Sounding the Sixth Trumpet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with angels, warriors, and celestial elements. The composition is detailed with various figures engaged in a tumultuous scene that appears to depict a heavenly battle or divine intervention. The figures are rendered in a detailed manner, with an emphasis on muscular forms and flowing drapery. Each character's expression and position adds to the dynamic feel of the scene, suggesting a narrative moment captured in suspended time. The use of light and shadow within the drawing creates depth and focuses attention on the central figures, while additional elements like swords, banners, and architectural features help build the setting. The artwork is likely a historical or religious depiction intended to convey themes of power, struggle, and divine justice.

artworks.title: Saint Michael and the Dragon
artworks.dimensions:
sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 29 × 20.5 cm (11 7/16 × 8 1/16 in.)
mount: 35.5 × 28 cm (14 × 11 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial battle scene. The image features figures with wings, armor, and weapons engaged in battle amongst swirling clouds. The central portion shows warriors, possibly angels, with large wings and carrying swords clashing with darkened figures. Below them are architectural structures resembling a medieval cityscape. The drawing is highly detailed, focusing on textures of the armor, the clouds, and the expressions of the figures, conveying movement and conflict dynamically.

artworks.title: The Fall of Babylon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical cityscape with mythological creatures. The image depicts a large, intricately detailed architectural setting featuring a towering structure. Mythological creatures are shown in the scene, with one appearing to ensnare human figures. Some figures float or hover amidst the chaos. The composition is dense and richly detailed, with elaborate patterns and textures throughout.

artworks.title: The Revelation of Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 29.7 × 21.2 cm (11 11/16 × 8 3/8 in.)
mount: 30.8 × 33.2 cm (12 1/8 × 13 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural and symbolic composition. The scene features an elaborate setting with arches and columns. A winged figure is seated with a book or manuscript in hand, accompanied by various symbolic elements such as an animal, a cherub, and a bird. Above them, a divine trinity is shown with flowing robes, clouds, and rays of light. The composition is detailed with intricate line work and textures, showcasing patterns and ornamentation.

artworks.title: The Triumph of the Unicorn
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23 × 39.5 cm (9 1/16 × 15 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession featuring mythological and fantastical elements. The composition includes numerous figures engaged in a ceremonial parade. The procession includes cherubic creatures, armored individuals, and ornately dressed figures carrying various objects. A central figure on a horse is surrounded by a cupid-like creature with wings. Stylized clouds serve as the backdrop. The figures and attire are detailed with hatching and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Unicorn Purifies the Water with Its Horn
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.5 × 40 cm (8 7/8 × 15 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a unicorn drinking from a stream in the center, surrounded by lions, boars, and deer. A stone bridge crosses the stream in the background, with a landscape of trees and a city with a castle visible beyond. The artwork is monochrome, using variations of soft grays to highlight the intricate etched lines.

artworks.title: The Feast of Anthony and Cleopatra  (Le festin d'Antoine et de Cleopatre)
artworks.artist: Jean-Honoré Fragonard after Giovanni Battista Tiepolo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered below a celestial figure. The scene is set in an ornate environment with individuals seated around a table. Above them, a figure sits amidst swirling clouds, possibly elevated on a rock. The drawing is detailed with elements such as clothes and gestures of the individuals.

artworks.title: Jacob Wrestling with the Angel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with livestock and figures. The drawing showcases a wide landscape that features numerous figures seemingly engaged in various activities across the composition. In the foreground, there is a gathering of people along with livestock, including camels, goats, and sheep. The figures and animals are tightly packed together, creating a sense of community or gathering. Further into the midground, more figures are seen leading herds of animals, primarily sheep and camels. Towards the right, there are figures with spears marching in formation. The linework is detailed and intricate, highlighting the expressive forms of both the human and animal characters within the scene.

artworks.title: Samson Slays the Philistines
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large figure blocking a cave entrance with a stone while others react. The drawing depicts a dynamic scene with a muscular, towering figure in the process of placing a large stone at the cave entrance. Surrounding the figure are smaller characters, some gesturing or reacting. The scene shows a crowded space with overlapping bodies in various poses. In the background are spears and vegetation. The style features detailed line work reminiscent of Renaissance pen and ink drawings.

artworks.title: Moses Striking the Rock
artworks.description: The image shows a group scene with animals and tents. It depicts a rocky landscape with water flowing from a rock, which is being licked by a camel, a donkey, and goats. Several figures stand in the foreground, draped in classical robes, some gesturing toward the water source. To the right, more figures are visible with containers, possibly filling them with water. Tents can be seen in the background to the right, indicating a camp setting. The drawing is finely detailed with cross-hatching to indicate shading and the contours of the figures.

artworks.title: The Lord Sweetens the Waters of Marah
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of men involved in a scene. The image features individuals in classical dress, standing and gesturing. Two figures in the forefront appear to be in a physical struggle, while another figure in the clouds above watches. The background shows a landscape with trees and structures. The detailed line work emphasizes the musculature and drapery of the figures, conveying a sense of classical themes and an epic or historical moment.

artworks.title: Old and Young Woman (Alte und jungere Frau)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people sitting at a table with only their upper bodies visible. The person on the left is seated in a slightly hunched position, with folded hands resting on the table. This person has angular facial features and short, dark hair. The person on the right is also seated, facing the person on the left, with dark, voluminous hair. Both figures wear dark, simple clothing. On the table, there is a bowl with rounded shapes inside and a pair of scissors. The background features vertical lines and abstract shapes or writing. The image is a monochromatic print in dark tones.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a knight fighting a dragon near a castle. The knight, riding a horse, is shown battling a defeated dragon. In the background, there is a castle on a rocky cliff. A regal figure is seen in the distance. The landscape includes hills and a river. The drawing is detailed with texture and line work conveying forms and movements.

artworks.title: Apollo and Marsyas
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure standing at the center with one hand raised and holding an object, while the other hand holds a large sword-like weapon. He has classical facial features, long hair with a leafy garland, and is almost nude with a drapery hanging from his waist. Various characters and elements of nature surround him, with muscular, armored men on the left and a struggling figure on the right. The background includes trees, a landscape, mountains, and a castle-like structure on the horizon. The scene is detailed with symbolic elements, typical of mythological and allegorical engravings.

artworks.title: Erasmus of Rotterdam
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting at a desk with various objects like an open book, a quill in an ink pot, a folded letter, and an hourglass. A decorated book titled "BIBLIA" is seen on the desk. In the background, there is a window showing a medieval town with a river, boats, and church towers. Inscriptions in Latin are on the wall.

artworks.title: Frederic Sylvester Douglas
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body in a three-quarter view. He is turned slightly to his left with a composed expression. His facial features are detailed, including sharp eyes and a prominent nose, and he has short, curly hair. The man is dressed in a formal outfit typical of the early 19th century, consisting of a high-collared shirt with a cravat, a waistcoat, and a jacket. There are no visible jewelry or objects on him. The background is plain, emphasizing the subject. Below the drawing, the name "The Hon[ora]ble Frederic Sylvester North Douglas," along with the years of birth and death, the artist's signature, and the date "1815" are inscribed.

artworks.title: Saint John on Patmos
artworks.description: The image shows a monochrome landscape with tall trees on the left, a townscape in the middle leading to distant mountains. On the right, there is a seated figure near a rock formation overlooking a water body with a horizontal horizon line. The water has a windmill and buildings along the shore. The sky has flowing clouds depicted with curved lines. The artwork showcases a range of textures and details, combining intricate elements with expansive vistas in grayscale.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Bacchus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Bacchanalian procession scene. The drawing includes a detailed chariot pulled by horses, surrounded by figures like satyrs and nymphs carrying musical instruments and festive items. The artwork is filled with twisting bodies and decorative elements, illustrating movement and energy typical of Bacchanalian scenes.

artworks.title: Lawyer Wade
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated at a table or desk. His body is angled slightly to the right as he leans forward. He has detailed facial features, a mustache, a prominent nose, and short, neatly combed back hair. He wears a dark suit with a formal collar. The man is holding a pen in his right hand, poised over a piece of paper. The background consists of dark, cross-hatching lines that suggest shadow and depth, with objects like a chair or writing desk behind him, indicating an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Prudence
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.7 x 8.1 cm (4 3/16 x 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological figure with a lion and a dragon. The central figure is depicted in a classical style, with long flowing hair and draped in fabric as she sits on a rock. A lion sits to her left, while a dragon is positioned on her right. The figure is holding an object in her left hand and her right hand is near the dragon. The drawing features careful detailing and evokes a sense of antiquity and myth.

artworks.title: The Hat Pin (Le chapeau epingle)
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person's upper body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is positioned slightly to the side, with their face oriented toward the right edge of the frame. The sketch captures the person's facial features with closed eyes and slightly parted lips. Their hair is depicted with flowing lines, mostly covered by a large hat with intricate detailing. The individual's clothing appears simple with soft folds, and their hand is resting against their face. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The background of the image contains abstract swirling and shading patterns, contrasting with the figure in the center of the composition.

artworks.title: The Two Bathers (Les deux baigneuses)
artworks.description: Two women are depicted in the image. One woman is sitting on the left, looking down and adjusting a large hat with a flower decoration. The other woman is crouched on the right, looking at her foot. They are both dressed in loose garments and surrounded by grass or foliage.
